    flags={
        "CALLS_DETERMINISTIC_ID":"deterministic_entry_client_order_id" in ncalls,
        "CALLS_EXECUTABLE_BUY_PRICE":"executable_buy_price" in ncalls,

    }
    for k,v in flags.items(): print("BUY_TEST_"+k+"="+("YES" if v else "NO"))
    if not all(flags.values()): errors.append("BUY_TEST_ID_EXPECTATION_NOT_CANONICAL")

# Restart/fail-closed test: actual restart, baseline snapshots, no hard-coded 100000.

if n:

    calls=[x for x in ast.walk(n) if isinstance(x,ast.Call)]

    brokers=[x for x in calls if cname(x)=="RakutenRssBroker"]
    state_expr=[]
    for b in brokers:
        for kw in b.keywords:
            if kw.arg=="state_file":
                state_expr.append(ast.dump(kw.value,include_attributes=False))
    same_state=len(state_expr)>=2 and len(set(state_expr))<len(state_expr)
    hardcoded100k=any(isinstance(x,ast.Constant) and isinstance(x.value,(int,float)) and float(x.value)==100000.0 for x in ast.walk(n))
    flags={

        "REFRESH_PENDING_ORDERS_CALLED": "refresh_pending_orders" in names,
        "POSITIVE_UPDATE_CONSTRUCTED": "RakutenRssOrderUpdate" in names,
        "FAIL_CLOSED_MARKER_ASSERTED": "FILL_EVENT_ID_NOT_PROVEN" in nseg,
        "NO_HARDCODED_100000": not hardcoded100k,
    }
    for k,v in flags.items(): print("FILL_TEST_"+k+"="+("YES" if v else "NO"))
    if not all(flags.values()): errors.append("FILL_TEST_BASELINE_RESTART_NOT_PROVEN")

# Broker remains read-only and safety evidence still present.
for token in ["client_order_id","immutable_payload_sha256","SUBMIT_ATTEMPTED","RECONCILE_PENDING","fill_event_id","applied_fill_events","FILL_EVENT_ID_NOT_PROVEN"]:

print("STATIC_VALIDATION_RESULT="+("FAIL" if errors else "PASS"))
